name: にちか
text:
……あ
今日特売セールだったっけ、牛乳
trans:
...Oh.
Was there a special sale on milk today?

name: 海外ドラマの字幕
text:
偶然なんてものはなく、すべては必然だなんて言う奴が
いるが、俺はそうは思わない
trans:
Some people say that there's no such thing as
coincidence, and that everything is inevitable,
but I don't think so.

name: 海外ドラマの字幕
text:
逆なんだ。必然なんてものはなく、
あるのはただ、偶然の連続
trans:
It's rather the opposite. There's no such thing as
inevitability. What exists is only a continuous series
of coincidences.

name: 海外ドラマの字幕
text:
そこに意味とか理由をつけたがるのが
人間の愚かなところさ
trans:
It's the foolishness of humans to try to attach
meaning and reasons to them.

name: スタッフ
text:
白瀬さんの撮影、以上となります
お疲れ様でしたー！
trans:
And that concludes Shirase-san's photoshoot.
Thank you for your hard work!

name: 咲耶
text: フフッ、こんなところで会うなんて奇遇だね
trans: Hehe, what a coincidence to meet you here.

name: 咲耶
text: どうしてこんなところに？

name: 透
text:
あー
乗っちゃって、逆方向
trans:
Ah.
I got on the train, but in the wrong direction.

name: 咲耶
text:
それなら、電車が来るまでの退屈しのぎに、
私とおしゃべりをするというのはどうだろう
trans:
If that's the case, would you like to chat the time
away until the train arrives?

name: 咲耶
trans:
Oh my...
Toru, did you have lunch?

name: 咲耶
text:
それは大変だ
次の駅で、何か食べて帰る？
trans:
We have to fix that.
Do you want to grab something the next station
before heading back?

name: レジスタッフ
text:
ポイントカードお返ししますー
……お会計、３番の端末でお願いいたします
trans:
Here's your loyalty card back.
...Please pay at number 3.

name: にちか
trans: ────Now I have to check another store.

name: 透
text:
やばい……
もう、コンビニとか
trans:
I'm dying...
A convenience store would be good...

name: 咲耶
text:
わかった
今調べるよ
trans:
Got it.
Let me look them up.

name: 咲耶
text:
コンビニは少し行かないとないみたいだ
近くに小さなスーパーがあるみたいだけれど……
trans:
It seems like there aren't any around here.
There is a small supermarket nearby, though...

name: 咲耶
text: 透、焼きそばパンあったよ────

name: 咲耶
text: 私たちも、さっき仕事帰りにバッタリ会ってね
trans:
Toru and I also bumped into each other on the way
back from work.

name: にちか
text:
あー……
そうなんですねー

name: にちか
text:
あ……えっと
いや……別に────

name: にちか
text:
すみません────
あの、失礼します……
trans:
Sorry────
I have somewhere to be...

name: 咲耶
text:
フフッ
透、鼻にソースが付いているよ
trans:
Hehe.
Toru, you got sauce on your nose.

name: 咲耶
text:
『一緒に焼きそばパンを食べよう』────
気軽にそう言えるくらいの関係になれたらいいな……
trans:
"Let's eat yakisoba bread together."────
I wish we could become close enough to tell her
something like that...

name: 透
text: まあ、あるんじゃないですか

name: 透
text:
七草さんが好きだったら
焼きそばパン
trans:
If Nanakusa-san likes it.
Yakisoba bread.

name: 咲耶
text:
透に言われると、
本当にそういう日が来るような気がするよ
trans:
When you say it like that,
it really feels like that day will come.
